description: Records a decision for a downstream MCP tool call (POST /v1/gateway/mcp). Vulnify maps the tool name to an action by substring and returns the same recorded decision as decide_action, including an id. This writes a security event and an audit entry. The tool arguments are not executed. The finalDecision field is the authoritative result. A REVIEW or BLOCK finalDecision means the downstream tool was not allowed. This server cannot approve the review. An idempotencyKey makes a retry return the same event.

agent.description: Agent name. Use this or agentId. A registered MCP route can supply a default agent.

agentId.description: Agent id (UUID). Use this or agent.

arguments.description: Tool arguments. Not executed by Vulnify.

content.description: Optional text scanned for sensitive data. Scanned in memory and not stored. This server does not log it.

destination.description: Where the data goes. Allowed values: INTERNAL, EXTERNAL_EMAIL, EXTERNAL_API.

idempotencyKey.description: Retries with the same key return the stored decision for 24 hours instead of recording another event.

recordsAffected.description: How many records the tool call would touch. Optional. 0 to 100000000.

resource.description: Resource name registered in Vulnify. Use this or resourceId.

resourceId.description: Resource id (UUID). Use this or resource.

routeId.description: Registered MCP route. Supplies a default agent.

tool.description: Downstream MCP tool name. Vulnify maps it to an action by substring. The tool is not executed.

name: check_mcp_tool_call

finalDecision.description: Authoritative result. Allowed values: ALLOW, REVIEW, BLOCK.

title: Check MCP tool call
